title: Water heater as space heater.
officialText:
Where a combination potable water heating and space heating system requires water for space
heating at temperatures higher than 140°F (60°C), a master thermostatic mixing valve complying with ASSE 1017 shall be provid ed
to limit the water supplied to the potable hot water distribution system to a temperature of 140°F (60°C) or less. The potability of
the water shall be maintained throughout the system.
